note: Literal true/false-positive samples from gitleaks rule sources. Each sample is written backwards, its letters moved 13 places and its digits 5 places (ROT13, ROT5), then base64-encoded, so secret scanners (which decode base64) do not mistake the fakes for real keys. To read one, base64-decode it, move the letters and digits back the same way, and reverse it. An [identifier, secret] pair stands for every template filled in ({i}, {I} upper case, {s}).
